title: A new name, a price change
hook: Two stated cases: explore a descriptive price change with unchanged toy cash flows.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How a descriptive price change with unchanged toy cash flows affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Final, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare a descriptive price change with unchanged toy cash flows in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
